_about: Yei Theodora Ozaki's (1870-1932) retellings of Japanese tales in English: Japanese Fairy Tales (1908), Warriors of Old Japan (1909) and Romances of Old Japan (1919; the Gutenberg file is Brentano's 1920 printing). Her own English from Japanese sources. Published before 1929: US public domain. Added at the coordinator's standing relay (2026-10-02: choose public-domain storytellers batches; Adam may veto).
